Download Dream League Soccer 2022 Mod Apk Obb (DLS 22) for Android, comes with latest players transfers and kits update, mod menu etc.

Dream League Soccer 2022 Mod Apk is a football game where you can build your dream team from thousands of licenced FIFPro teams to compete with best Soccer clubs from around the world in real time.

Play through eight divisions with Immersive 3D – gameplay, in-depth commentary, team customisations, updated player moves and skills etc.

Ability to build your dream team is one of the best features of DLS 2022 Mod Apk, Sign players like Messi, Ronaldo, Mpepe, Salah, Isco and many more players by developing them to compete through the ranks of divisions available within Dream League game.

With improved game play, new animations showing players skills and movement within the pitch gives you the best experience of Dream League Soccer 2022.

You can customise your dream League Soccer from different options available within the game such as customizing player hairs, socks, kits and boots.

The Mod Menu available within DLS 2022 Mod Apk lets you take control of how players behave around the pitch, even though ability to use unlimited amount of money is still limited in the current edition of the game.

Features Of Dream League Soccer 2022 Mod 

  • New Team and players data updated.
  • New improved menu and user interface.
  • New team facilities with recruitment center, unlockable perks added.
  • Improved game play.
  • New kits template added.
  • Sound track updated.
  • Snow whether from FTS also added.
  • More officials, staffs, fans, flags, banners added to make DLS 22 look realistic.
  • Mod Menu added to control players.
